item.tib: zab lam ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul gyi gdams pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis me mo glang gi lor yum chen byams ma rang byon ngo mtshar bzhi ldan bzhugs pa'i gsang brag seng+ge rgyab bsnol thugs rje dkon phug nas skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dbang po'i spyod yul du snang ba dngos grub tu babs te slar shing mo bya yi lor thugs sprul ri bo chen po'i zhol stag rtse g.yung drung gling gi sprul pa'i sku g.yung drung bstan pa dbang rgyal gyis bskul ngor g.yung drung gling gi yang dben du gtan la dbab ste yi ge pa ni tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pas phyogs dus kun tu dge legs 'phel rgyas su gyur cig/
